Finding: The strict PDCCH validator supports only DCI formats 0_0 and 1_0.
RequiredFix: Implement release-pinned DCI 0_1 and 1_1 layouts, field sizing, BWP/carrier/antenna-port/CSI requests, CRC scrambling, and grant reconstruction before enabling them.
AcceptanceTest: Bit-exact encode/decode vectors and blind-search tests cover every supported format and contextual size.

Finding: Partial DCI 0_1/1_1 payload structures exist without complete contextual sizing and end-to-end ownership.
Evidence: DCI payload helpers; conformance matrix limitations
RequiredFix: Delete or fence partial layouts from strict execution; rebuild sizing from canonical RRC/BWP/resource-allocation context and decoded field semantics.
AcceptanceTest: Strict mode cannot select partial formats; completed formats round-trip independent vectors and drive actual grants.

Finding: Type-0 PDCCH derivation is constrained to a 30-kHz, CORESET0 index 0, SearchSpace0 index 0 mini anchor.
RequiredFix: Implement complete selected-release CORESET0/SearchSpace0 lookup tables by frequency, SSB SCS, common SCS, and pdcch-ConfigSIB1.
AcceptanceTest: Every supported pdcch-ConfigSIB1 value maps to independent expected CORESET0/search-space parameters; invalid combinations fail.

Finding: The Type-0 helper hard-codes aggregation level 4, one candidate, 32 DCI payload bits, and fixed timing assumptions.
RequiredFix: Derive candidate counts, aggregation levels, monitoring occasion, payload size, and timing from the pinned tables and actual DCI context.
AcceptanceTest: Table/vector tests validate candidate sets and payload sizes over the supported Type-0 matrix.

Finding: SI-RNTI, RA-RNTI, TC-RNTI, P-RNTI, CS-RNTI and other RNTI-specific search/CRC/procedure combinations are not broadly integrated.
RequiredFix: Add explicit RNTI types, search-space ownership, CRC mask, DCI applicability, procedure state, and negative wrong-RNTI tests.
AcceptanceTest: Each supported RNTI decodes only in the correct search space/procedure and wrong masks produce no false grant.

Finding: PDCCH BWP switching, cross-carrier scheduling, carrier indicators, and search-space association are not end-to-end.
Evidence: conformance matrix; no strict multi-BWP PDCCH profile
RequiredFix: Carry serving-cell/BWP/search-space/CORESET identity through DCI encode, monitoring, blind search, grant reconstruction, scheduler, and evidence.
AcceptanceTest: Two-BWP/two-CC tests prove the DCI is monitored and applied only on the intended control/data resources.

Finding: Beam-specific PDCCH monitoring, QCL/TCI association, beam failure detection, and recovery are incomplete.
RequiredFix: Implement control-resource-set TCI state, SSB/CSI-RS QCL sources, beam-switch timing, monitoring occasions, and failure/recovery procedures.
AcceptanceTest: Beam switch and blocked-beam scenarios show correct monitoring/decoding and recovery with observed beam provenance.

Finding: Some blind-search execution depends on externally supplied candidate timing or disables timing estimation rather than performing complete monitoring.
RequiredFix: Build monitoring occasions and candidates entirely from decoded/configured state; perform timing/CFO acquisition within the declared strict profile or require a separately named synchronized calibration profile.
AcceptanceTest: Blind-search test starts from waveform plus allowed synchronization state only and finds the correct candidate without oracle indices.

Finding: Legacy study control modules and nontransparent stubs remain close to production paths and can be confused with strict PDCCH behavior.
RequiredFix: Physically isolate study/stub packages, add runtime prohibition in strict profiles, and label every output from a stub as unavailable/non-conformant.
AcceptanceTest: Dependency scan shows strict packages cannot import stub modules; a deliberate stub selection fails before run.

Finding: A PDCCH detector contains undefined “6G SCS” placeholder behavior.
RequiredFix: Remove it from NR strict paths; define an explicit experimental waveform numerology interface and research-only tests if retained.
AcceptanceTest: NR profile never executes placeholder code; research profile labels it non-normative and requires explicit parameters.

Finding: CORESET REG/CCE mapping, interleaving, bundle sizes, shift index, precoder granularity, and candidate enumeration lack a complete independent matrix.
Evidence: PDCCH strict tests are focused mini profiles
RequiredFix: Add table-driven mapping tests and pure-math expected RE/REG/CCE indices for every supported combination.
AcceptanceTest: Independent maps match TX/RX, and one-bit/mapping perturbations are detected.

Finding: False-alarm, missed-detection, wrong-RNTI, wrong-aggregation, no-signal, and low-SNR tests exist but are not a statistically complete campaign across the supported control matrix.
Evidence: PDCCH artifact set and focused tests
RequiredFix: Create a multi-seed detection campaign with declared probability bounds per format/AL/channel/impairment and enforce confidence intervals.
AcceptanceTest: Campaign meets configured false-alarm and detection bounds with no incomplete points.

Finding: Decoded DCI is not the sole authority for all data grants and scheduler state.
RequiredFix: Make decoded DCI plus installed RRC/MAC state the only strict connected-mode grant source; expose configured grants only in calibration profiles.
AcceptanceTest: Oracle-grant mutation no longer changes strict execution; decoded-bit mutation does.

Finding: DCI field sizing and payload packing are not covered by an independent release/versioned vector catalog.
RequiredFix: Create spec-derived vectors for each supported format under multiple BWP/resource/context sizes and verify both pack and parse.
AcceptanceTest: All vectors round-trip bit-exactly; wrong context produces a controlled size/semantic failure.
